sentences.en: It is not always easy to distinguish good from evil.
sentences.zh: 区分善与恶并不总是容易。

sentences.en: The allies defeated the evil empire in the fierce battle.
sentences.zh: 盟友在激烈的战斗中击败了邪恶帝国。

sentences.en: An experienced healer can lift curses and dispel evil eyes.
sentences.zh: 一位有经验的治疗师可以解除诅咒，驱散邪眼。

senses.zh: 邪恶的；有害的；不幸的；讨厌的 -
